description: A React functional component named 'ExecutionPanel' that displays detailed information about a workflow execution, including status, timing, identifiers, associated workflow, and child executions. It provides UI elements for copying IDs and navigating execution details.

methods.name: ExecutionPanel
methods.description: Main React component rendering the execution details panel, with hooks for state management, formatting functions, and event handlers for copying data to clipboard.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Asynchronous function that writes text to the clipboard and temporarily updates UI state to show copy confirmation.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Converts a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string (ms, s, m).

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp string into an object with formatted date, time, and relative time.

methods.name: getRelativeTime
methods.description: Calculates relative time string (Just now, X m/h/d ago) based on a past date.
